Class EnumSetTableCellEditor<E extends Enum<E>>

java.lang.Object
javax.swing.AbstractCellEditor
uno.anahata.asi.swing.components.EnumSetTableCellEditor<E>
Type Parameters:
E - The specific enum type.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, CellEditor, TableCellEditor
public class EnumSetTableCellEditor<E extends Enum<E>> extends AbstractCellEditor implements TableCellEditor
A generic, reusable TableCellEditor for editing sets or lists of Enum constants.

Employs EnumSetComboBox as the interactive editing component, providing a sleek dropdown with real-time multi-checkbox toggling and automatic commit upon popup closure.

Author:
anahata
